usageNotes: Permanently deletes a named snapshot from a remote LXC container; the operation is asynchronous and returns a remote UPID that should be polled for completion. The caller must hold Resource.Manage on the remote/vmid ACL path, and the target PVE node must be reachable from PDM. If the snapshot has dependent child snapshots, deletion will fail — remove children first.

examples.summary: Delete a pre-upgrade snapshot from a remote LXC container

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named snapshot and its stored disk delta; the container state captured at that point in time cannot be recovered.
tips: The returned UPID is a remote UPID — use the appropriate PDM task-status endpoint (not local PVE task endpoints) to poll for completion.
Omitting 'node' lets PDM resolve the node automatically; specify it only when the container is on a specific node in a multi-node cluster.
Snapshot names follow the same alphanumeric-plus-dots-dashes pattern as on local PVE — max 40 characters.
Run list_pve_remotes_remote_lxc_vmid_snapshot first to confirm the exact snapname before deleting.
